lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every night in Starwood, the stars glimmered like lanterns above the forest.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: Pip, are you awake? Look at that one. It's brighter than all the others.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: That's the North Lantern. It always points the way home.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: Then why is it trembling? It's almost as if...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The light flickered once, twice, and vanished from the sky.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: Pip! It's gone. Can a star just disappear?

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Stars don't usually do that. Wait, do you hear something?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: From the deepest part of the forest, a small golden lantern rose into the mist.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: I think it's asking us to follow!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Or warning us not to. Let's look carefully before we move.

lines.speaker: luma
lines.text: Together, then. One step at a time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Inside the lantern, a tiny map appeared. On it was a place neither friend had ever seen.

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Luma... that place is right beneath our feet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And somewhere far below, something answered with three slow knocks.
